title: Group Conversations
drDigitalIntro:
A group chat lets you message several people at once.

- Tap the + button in the Contacts header to start a new group.
- Pick the people you want to add — a checkmark appears next to each one.
- Hit Start Chat and a group thread opens.
- Everyone in the group can see all the messages.
- Great for planning events, staying in touch with family, or working on a project together.

playgroundTask.goal: You created a group chat and sent your first message

steps.say: Click the + button next to Contacts to start a new group.
Check the box next to Alex to add them to the group.
Check the box next to Jordan too.
Click Start Chat to open the group — then type anything and send it.

drDigitalSuccess: You created a group chat! Everyone in the group will see your messages — perfect for making plans with friends and family.
drDigitalHint: Click the + button at the top of the contacts list. Check Alex and Jordan, then click Start Chat. Type anything and send.
